name: OnlineFix
notes: OnlineFix build: Steam has to be running and logged in while you play (online play goes through Steam's Spacewar app).

name: Heated Metal (Rainbow Six Siege)
notes: Heated Metal build: stock Proton crashes in HeatedMetal.dll. Use the Proton build from the Heated Metal Discord (install it with: proton-porter install-proton ARCHIVE).

name: BepInEx
notes: BepInEx mod loader found: its winhttp.dll override is turned on. First start generates the config and can take a while.

name: MelonLoader
notes: MelonLoader found: its version.dll override is turned on. First start downloads/generates assemblies and is slow.

name: Skyrim Script Extender (SKSE)
notes: SKSE found: add skse64_loader.exe (not the game's .exe) as the game in Steam, or Proton starts the game without it.

name: Fallout 4 Script Extender (F4SE)
notes: F4SE found: add f4se_loader.exe as the game in Steam.

name: New Vegas Script Extender (NVSE)
notes: NVSE found: add nvse_loader.exe as the game in Steam.

name: ASI loader (Ultimate ASI Loader)
notes: ASI plugins found. The loader DLL (dinput8/dsound/winmm/version/d3d9...) next to the .exe needs a native override; the detected one is turned on.

name: ReShade
notes: ReShade found: its dxgi/d3d9/d3d11/opengl32 DLL needs a native override (turned on automatically when detected). Under DXVK it works for D3D9-11 games.

name: Reloaded-II
notes: Reloaded-II found. It is a .NET app: it needs `protontricks <appid> dotnet8` (or a recent Proton-GE) to start.

name: CODEX / Steam emulator
notes: Steam emulator files found. Works without Steam running; Proton-GE is the safer choice.

name: Goldberg Steam emulator
notes: Goldberg emulator found. Saves may live next to the game (local_save.txt) or under C:\users\steamuser\AppData\Roaming\Goldberg SteamEmu Saves.
